passages.text: Nothing astonishes men so much as common sense and plain dealing. All great actions have been simple, and all great pictures are.
passages.note: Overcomplicating things; the power of simplicity and honesty

passages.text: The sweetest music is not in the oratorio, but in the human voice when it speaks from its instant life tones of tenderness, truth, or courage.

The sun set; but set not his hope:
Stars rose; his faith was earlier up:
Fixed on the enormous galaxy,
Deeper and older seemed his eye:
And matched his sufferance sublime
The taciturnity of time.
passages.note: Holding on to hope and patience through dark times
